request.message: Purple glass vase ka light-sweep video prompt original likho. Camera ko bhi move karne ki zarurat hai kya?

response.answer:
L06 Light Sweep

```text
Use the uploaded image as the first frame. The [PRODUCT] stays perfectly still and exactly the same the whole time — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing, no warping. The camera stays completely still. A soft band of warm light slowly sweeps across the [PRODUCT] from left to right, the shadows moving gently with it. Clean premium product video. No people, no hands, no text on screen. Soft quiet room ambience only — NO music, NO voice.
```

Bache hue brackets mein apni details bharo; maine koi details invent nahi ki hain.

result.excerpts:
[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L06 Light Sweep (course-material) [Lesson 06; lesson_6]
Use the uploaded image as the first frame. The [PRODUCT] stays perfectly still and exactly the same the whole time — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing, no warping. The camera stays completely still. A soft band of warm light slowly sweeps across the [PRODUCT] from left to right, the shadows moving gently with it. Clean premium product video. No people, no hands, no text on screen. Soft quiet room ambience only — NO music, NO voice.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product video (course-material) [Lesson 06; lesson_6]
• Flow → Video → Ingredients → photo daalo. • Course settings: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1. • Ek movement: push-in / arc / light sweep. Music nahi — baad mein editing mein.
Reviewed English translation: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the image. Recorded course settings: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1. Choose one slow movement: push-in, arc or light sweep. Keep the product perfectly still with no morphing or warping. Add music later during editing.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
• Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.
Reviewed English translation: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the face, character sheet and product sheet. Recorded settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. The camera itself is the phone: no phone should appear in the frame. Use a normal home room and short dialogue written in Hindi Devanagari, based on the L05 hook. Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Course overview and prerequisites (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.
Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Lesson 06 — Photo Se Product Video (course-material) [Lesson 06; lesson_6]
Photo Se Product Video Ingredients mode, ek movement: push-in, arc, light sweep

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video mein phone dikh raha (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
UGC video mein phone dikh raha "The camera itself is her phone. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame." (L07)
Reviewed English translation: Add the course FAQ instruction: “The camera itself is her phone. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame.”
